subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Inferir o sentido de palavras ou expressões desconhecidas em textos, com base no contexto da frase ou do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar palavras desconhecidas encontradas em um texto informativo
components.description_en: Identify unknown words encountered in an informational text
components.cc_component_description: Identify unknown words encountered in an informational text

components.description_pt: Usar pistas de contexto em nível de sentença para determinar o significado de palavra desconhecida
components.description_en: Use sentence-level context clues to determine the meaning of an unknown word
components.cc_component_description: Use sentence-level context clues to determine the meaning of an unknown word

cc_matches.description: With prompting and support, ask and answer questions about unknown words in a text.
Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 2 reading and content, choosing flexibly from an array of strategies.
